sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Built on the architectural foundation of Qwen3.5, Qwen3.8 delivers substantial gains across coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks.

sources.title: lribeiro/Qwen3.8-27B-FP8-Pessoa · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Pessoa is the FP8 weight-only winner from a systematic 97-model quantization sweep of Qwen3.8-27B, exploring NVFP4, MXFP8, and FP8 formats via both ModelOpt (NVIDIA) and GPTQ (llm-compressor).

sources.title: Qwen 3.8 Quant Selection Guide for RTX 5090
sources.snippet: The title of this post is a targeted guide, somebody who wants to fit Q3.8-27b into a single 5090 and would like to see the trade-offs between precision and performance.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B | vLLM Recipes
sources.snippet: 27B-parameter dense hybrid-attention model with linear attention on 48 of 64 layers, a vision tower, a built-in MTP draft head, 262K native context window and extensible to 1M context. Fits one Blackwell GPU in every precision: NVFP4 in 24.6 GiB, 6.6M KV tokens at 1M context.

sources.title: Como executar o Qwen3.8-27B localmente em uma NVIDIA RTX 5090
sources.snippet: A RTX 5090 é particularmente adequada ao Qwen3.8-27B porque sua arquitetura Blackwell oferece suporte a NVFP4, permitindo rodar o modelo em altíssimas velocidades sem abrir mão da qualidade de saída.
